summary: FB Financial Corp filed an 8-K announcing its board renewed a stock repurchase plan authorizing up to $175 million of common stock repurchases, running until June 30, 2027, replacing a prior authorization. Repurchases may be executed via open market or private transactions under Rule 10b-18, with timing and amount subject to market conditions, regulatory constraints, and alternative capital uses. No specific price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The plan reflects disciplined capital management and can be suspended anytime. Watch for execution pace and potential buyback impact on share price given the open-ended mechanics.
